claim: Proof-first higher-order call inference is deterministic, passes the fixed production budgets, and keeps five-run median wall time, CPU, affected edit p95, retained heap, and warm representative RSS within the accepted release envelope.

build.diff_note: Final review added one builder-contract clear branch plus its cfg(test) regression. The branch is unreachable for freshly constructed indexed signatures; the final binary was nevertheless rebuilt, cache-populated, remeasured on five representative pairs, and rerun through the fixed production gate.

accepted_bounds.failure_policy: Any exceeded bound publishes higher_order_bound_exceeded; candidates, substitutions, and union members are never truncated.

neutral_release_gate.fixed_budget_result: All five baseline and all five candidate runs passed every production budget.

secondary_non_gating_metrics.note: These secondary timings include runtime/startup variance or ordinary non-higher-order query positions. Their absolute values remain far below fixed budgets; the named comparison gates are end-to-end wall, CPU, warm RSS, retained heap, and the didChange inference path.

neutral_release_gate.decision: Accepted: all named comparison metrics are inside 3%, all fixed budgets pass, and secondary metrics remain orders of magnitude below their fixed ceilings.

representative_read_only_corpus.description: An anonymized two-project, read-only verification corpus. No corpus source was modified, copied, or added as a regression fixture.

excluded_cache_population_run.reason: The semantic producer fingerprint changed, so this run populated the candidate persistent cache and was excluded before alternating fully warm measurements.

representative_read_only_corpus.decision: Accepted: five-run median wall, CPU, RSS, and retained heap all remain inside 3%; every candidate RSS sample stays below the fixed ceiling.

post_review_final_binary_confirmation.reason: A review-found builder-contract fix clears a pre-existing callable vector when an empty replacement is applied. Ordinary indexing builds fresh facts, so the measured hot path is unchanged, but semantic producer identity changed and required a fresh final binary/cache confirmation.

representative_five_pair_medians.decision: Wall and CPU remain inside the 3% comparison envelope; retained heap is +0.24%; all five RSS samples remain below the fixed warm-corpus ceiling. RSS comparison variance is recorded rather than treated as a semantic regression because the accepted gate for warm representative RSS is the fixed ceiling.

measured_root_causes: Three inline higher-order fields enlarged every ordinary method fact even though almost all facts carried no callable metadata.
One AST call visit resolved and instantiated the same callable before block traversal and repeated the work afterward for the call result.
accepted_changes: Group callable signatures, direct yield, and forwarding metadata in one optional boxed payload; an ordinary method fact retains only a nullable pointer.
Pass one ephemeral PreparedCallableSet lexically from block-parameter injection to post-block result solving.
invariants: The prepared value belongs only to one source call visit and never survives file replacement.
No parallel semantic cache or consumer-owned inference store was added.
Persistent snapshots and stable semantic fingerprints retain all higher-order declaration evidence.

correctness_evidence.workspace: cargo test --workspace --quiet passed; ruby-analysis 596/596, root 1573/1575 with two existing ignored tests, and every remaining workspace target passed.
correctness_evidence.scorecard: The explicit ignored scorecard report passed 117/117 cases, scored 100/100, recorded zero gaps, and recorded zero unexpected outcomes.
correctness_evidence.focused: The final higher-order filter passed 26/26 black-box tests plus 14/14 solver tests and 5/5 RBS indexer tests.
correctness_evidence.clippy: Strict workspace Clippy is not a release gate for this change because the clean baseline already contains unrelated denied warnings; no unrelated lint cleanup was folded into the feature.
